ticket.title: benchwork migrate must discard derived caches rather than move them, and must describe docs.toml consolidation
ticket.description: Retitled 2026-11-06: the original claim that migrate 'sees neither .storypole nor .miter' was my misreading (I ran it at the suite root, the one repo with no legacy dirs). Per repo it detects both correctly. What remains: (1) it proposes moving the whole .storypole directory, which contains index.sqlite, -shm and -wal - a derived cache must be discarded rather than migrated or a stale index will be opened and lie; (2) at the root it would ARCHIVE .gaugeblock/docs.toml with no merge described, which needs confirming as consolidation rather than discard; (3) the dry-run names source and destination but not per-item classification or conflict handling (GB-255), which is what makes a nine-repo run reviewable.
acceptance_criteria: CODE DONE 2026-11-06 (benchwork commit): engine.rs now discards index.sqlite/-shm/-wal after a DirectoryMove via discard_caches()
and both the dry-run line and the applied receipt report the count ('would discard 2 derived cache files' / 'discarded 2')

so a fleet review cannot mistake a discard for a move. The copy fallback path is covered because discarding happens at the destination after the rename-or-copy.\n\nVerification: clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean
fmt clean
migration test green. NOT verified end-to-end on a real repo
because outfeed install said '(up-to-date)' - it compares the crate version

which did not change - so the installed binary is still the old one (mtime Nov 6 00:10 against a 12:30 source file). GB-264 filed for that. Phase 1 on rabbet is therefore blocked until either install can be forced or the version changes.

task.title: benchwork migrate sees neither .storypole nor .miter, and treats live .gaugeblock/docs.toml as legacy

acceptance_criteria: CORRECTION 2026-11-06: the 'sees neither .storypole nor .miter' half of this report was WRONG and was my misreading. Run at the suite root it reports only docs.toml
because the root is the one repository with no legacy directories; run inside rabbet
benchwork
miter and outfeed it correctly reports .storypole -> .gaugeblock/storypole
and in miter also .miter -> .gaugeblock/miter. discovery.rs knows all three shapes and the tool is repo-scoped by design.\n\nWhat actually remains
and it is much smaller: (1) the dry run proposes moving the whole .storypole directory
which contains index.sqlite
-shm and -wal - a derived cache must be discarded rather than migrated
or a stale index will be opened and lie; (2) at the root it says it would ARCHIVE .gaugeblock/docs.toml with no merge step described
which needs confirming as a consolidation rather than a discard; (3) the dry-run output names source and destination but not per-item classification or conflict handling
which is GB-255 and is what makes a nine-repo run reviewable.\n\nDowngrading in effect: not a detection bug
a cache-handling and reporting gap.
